text: The enclosed recommendation is to rescind the existing maximum 10-minute parking limit in effect from 4:00 pm to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday on Foxbar Road. This regulation is no longer required as the daycare at Deer Park United Church has been relocated, as the building has been incorporated within the redevelopment project at 129 St. Clair Avenue West.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Rescinded the existing maximum 10-minute parking limit in effect from 4:00 p.m. and 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the west side of Foxbar Road, between a point 15 metres south of St. Clair Avenue West and a point 53.6 metres further south.
